* Bachelor's Degree in Relevant Field

* Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience

* Knowledge of industrial automation products and the software ecosystems that configure, connect, monitor, or support them
* Familiarity with Rockwell Automation software, variable frequency drive, or motion product portfolios is highly desired
* Ability to collaborate effectively across commercial, product management, software engineering, architecture, quality, and program teams

* Ability to communicate complex technical and business information clearly to multiple levels of stakeholders
* Understanding of business profit and loss responsibility

title: Staff Product Manager, Time & Attendance
description:
**Overview**
------------

**Overview**

Small businesses drive the global economy. In the US, SMBs employ 60% of the labor force and create 80% of new jobs. However, the stakes are high, as 1 in 2 businesses will fail to survive within their first five years. In an environment where time is money, precise time tracking for payroll, invoicing, and project management is the critical lever for maintaining profitability and growing the business.

Within QuickBooks, our Workforce platform fuels productivity for growing teams — from time tracking and scheduling to project management and field operations. With 30M+ employees in the QuickBooks ecosystem and 18M paid through Workforce Solutions, we are building the essential tools that empower frontline teams and help businesses turn time into money.

**Opportunity**

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to lead the verticalization of QuickBooks Time. You’ll make our time tracking platform the system of record for hours, labor cost, and payroll in the industries where labor is the highest cost, starting with construction and field services. Time is the source of hours for the entire QuickBooks ecosystem. Customers use the hours their teams track to run payroll, bill for their work, and understand whether each job is making money, and the mid-market businesses we serve need all three to work together without spreadsheets or re-entry.

This is a high-ownership role. You will own three connected areas end to end: time to payroll, so approved hours, overtime, and pay items flow into QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automagically; job costing, so every hour tracked produces labor cost estimates against projects and budgets before payroll runs and accurate actuals after it; and worker time tracking across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers track their time. You will build on Time 2.0, our rebuilt time platform that now lives inside QuickBooks Online, and extend it so that serving a new industry is mostly configuration rather than new code.

We need a scrappy, customer-obsessed product leader who leads through influence. Someone who navigates dependencies across Payroll, Projects, Mid-Market, and Payments, earns the trust and confidence of our customers and accountants, and ships experiences that delight both the worker clocking in on a job site and the admin who approves time and runs payroll.

**Responsibilities**

**Responsibilities**

* **Vertical Strategy.** Own the multi-year roadmap for verticalizing QuickBooks Time, starting with construction and field services. Translate how each industry runs its labor (jobs, cost codes, phases, and certified payroll on a construction site; jobs, visits, and dispatch in field services) into shared platform concepts and configurable experiences, so that each new vertical is mostly configuration rather than new code. Decide what we build, what we configure, and where partner integrations fill the gap.
* **Time to Payroll.** Own the flow of hours from clock-in to paycheck. Make approved time, overtime and break policies, and pay items land in QuickBooks Payroll accurately and automatically, with no exports, syncs, or re-entry, and make approvals fast and trustworthy for a mid-market company with hundreds of employees.
* **Job Costing: Estimates and Actuals.** Deliver real-time labor costing that owners, project managers, and accountants trust. Partner with Projects, Payroll, and Accounting so that time is the single source of hours for payroll, invoicing, and profitability reporting.
* **Worker Time Tracking.** Own how workers track time across Workforce Web, Workforce Kiosk, and the Workforce mobile app, where millions of workers already track their hours. Deliver one consistent, reliable experience for clocking in and out, breaks, schedules, geofencing, and job and task selection that holds up on a job site with poor connectivity and for crews whose first language is not English, and complete the migration of workers off legacy TSheets surfaces onto the new platform.
* **Commercial Impact.** Own the metrics for your area: Time adoption within Workforce Premium and Elite offerings, attached in mid-market and industry editions. Plus worker engagement across web, kiosk, and mobile. Use data and customer evidence to prioritize, measure what ships, and make Time and real-time job costing a central part of how QuickBooks is sold to construction and field services customers, a market where competitors generate $150M+ ARR.
* **Operational Velocity.** Run the end-to-end product lifecycle for your area: write crisp requirements, pressure-test designs, manage edge cases, and drive alignment across engineering, design, data, go-to-market, and customer success teams in the US and India. You lead through influence rather than authority, and you are fluent in AI-native tools like Claude and Cursor, using them to move faster from insight to shipped product.
* **Customer Empathy.** Be the voice of the business owner, the payroll admin, and the frontline worker. Spend time with customers on their job sites and with the accountants who recommend HCM products to their clients, and make sure every feature removes a real pain point in how they bid, schedule, track, pay, and get paid.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

* **A Product Leader.** 8+ years of product management craft, including ownership of a complex, multi-team product area as a senior individual contributor. You have a proven track record of building and scaling customer-facing products in HCM, workforce management, construction or field service software, or fintech.
* **Strategic & Influential.** You possess strong executive presence, translating market and customer insight into a strategy and roadmap that align senior stakeholders and technical teams. You make bold bets and bring partner teams along without direct authority.
* **Domain Depth.** You understand how labor-intensive businesses run: how hours become payroll, how time, cost rates, and pay types become job costs, and how estimates compare to actuals. Experience with payroll, time and attendance, job costing, or construction and field service workflows is a strong advantage.
* **A Proven Growth Driver.** You have a track record of spearheading complex initiatives that deliver measurable business growth. You understand the levers of adoption, attach, ARPC, and retention, and you use them to prioritize and to drive P&L growth.
* **An Ambitious Problem Solver.** You proactively anticipate customer and stakeholder needs, thrive in ambiguity and turn complex, messy friction into clear roadmaps. You are scrappy and effective at managing a portfolio of bets across the lifecycle, from 0-1 innovations to products at scale. You know when to push forward and when to pivot based on evidence and stakeholder feedback.
* **Customer Obsessed & Analytical.** You possess deep empathy for small and mid-market business operations and frontline workforce challenges. You combine this heart with rigorous analytical aptitude, storytelling with data to prioritize investments.
* **Technical Fluency.** You demonstrate strong product judgment and comfort engaging across technical topics to build reliable web, mobile, and kiosk products on a shared platform, including APIs, data models, and integrations with payroll and accounting systems. Experience with agentic AI, payment systems, or HCM platforms is an advantage.
* **Education.** BA or BS degree is required, and an MBA or advanced degree is preferred.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

As our first dedicated Product Management professional, you will also establish the product function at 2Base: there is no existing roadmap, process or product organisation to inherit.

Key Responsibilities

Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap and long-term direction, and keep the roadmap stable enough to plan against and open enough to change when the evidence changes.  
Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and customer discovery to identify and validate product opportunities, and bring the findings into roadmap decisions rather than filing them as reports.  
Translate customer problems and business needs into clear product requirements: the outcome and the user problem, specified well enough for Engineering to build against without dictating the solution.  
Own feature prioritisation and release decisions with Engineering and UI/UX, and be able to state the cost and the benefit of each choice. A roadmap that only says yes is a backlog.  
Identify and evaluate AI, Generative AI and automation opportunities, and assess each on feasibility, scalability, cost and business value before it reaches the roadmap.  
Define product success metrics before the work starts, instrument the product to measure them, and read the results honestly afterwards.  
Contribute to product positioning, pricing, go-to-market strategy and commercial viability, working with Sales and Marketing.  
Build shared context across the organisation so that teams can make decisions without routing every question through you.  
Work closely with the Founder, Engineering, UI/UX, Sales and other stakeholders to align on product direction and drive execution.

What You Will Not Own  
​  
Product Manager and Project Manager are used interchangeably across the market. At 2Base, they are different roles, so the boundary is stated rather than assumed.  
Client project delivery. Project Managers own client engagements, schedules, and escalations.  
Engineering architecture and implementation. You own what and why; Engineering owns how. Where the two conflict, you negotiate rather than instruct.  
UI/UX design execution. The design function designs. You own the user outcome and brief, review and decide against it.  
Final product investment and budget approval. The Founder decides what the product is funded to do and over what horizon. You own the case that decision is taken on.  
Client-specific commercial negotiations. Pricing and packaging of the product itself is yours; client contracts are not.

Requirements  
Experience

6–12 years in the technology industry, with at least 4 years in Product Management or direct product ownership.  
At least one product you took from concept or early development to actual customer usage, with a clear view of what happened after release. A product you inherited fully formed and maintained is a weaker signal than a smaller one you shaped.  
A decision not to build something, and what it cost you to hold that line.  
Direct work with engineering teams through a build, not across a handover, with enough understanding of software development, technical feasibility, APIs, integrations and cloud applications to judge what a decision will cost.  
AI and Emerging Technology  
Practical exposure to AI-powered products, Generative AI, machine learning or automation-driven solutions.  
The ability to tell a capability apart from a product, and to assess an AI use case on feasibility, scalability, cost and business value rather than on novelty.  
Product Judgement

You can describe how you decided what to build: the evidence you had, the evidence you wanted and did not have, and what you did about the gap.  
You can reason about a product commercially. Who pays, what for, and what has to be true for the numbers to work.  
You can hold a position with a founder, an engineering lead or a client, and change it when the argument against you is the better one. Knowing which situation you are in is the skill.  
You write and present clearly. Most of a product manager's influence here travels as writing, and a requirement that is ambiguous on Monday becomes an argument three weeks later.  
Ways of Working  
You start by asking rather than deciding. The first months are spent understanding users, the business model, what has already been attempted, and how decisions are actually made here.  
You work independently and establish your own processes. There is no research function and no analyst to brief.  
You influence without formal authority. Nobody in this structure reports to you, and the roadmap holds because people agree with it.  
You can make a decision that leaves someone unhappy, explain the reasoning, and keep working with them. Trade-offs are the job, and somebody loses every time one is made.  
Education

A Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

What We Are Not Looking For  
Stated now rather than at the end of a multi-stage process.  
Project or delivery managers looking to change title. The skills overlap less than the market suggests, and this is not a promotion path from delivery.  
Business analysts who have written specifications against requirements someone else set. Valuable work; different work.  
Candidates whose account of a product is the features it shipped, with no view on whether it should have shipped them.  
Anyone who needs an established research function, design system and process in place before they can start.

Benefits  
A growth-driven environment with opportunities to lead, innovate, and upskill continuously.

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

description:
This is a growth-stage product operator role, not a 0-to-1 role. Webnyay has a mature product, established enterprise customers, live deployments, and meaningful transaction volumes across dispute resolution and grievance redressal.

Our platform powers complex workflows across arbitration, mediation, online dispute resolution, and BFSI grievance management. The product is live, the customers are real, and the operational challenges are substantial.

Your job is to grow it — through better, faster, and more scalable versions of what works, while building new capabilities that expand what our customers can do with Webnyay.

You should be comfortable working with complex workflows, demanding enterprise customers, and engineering teams. You should be equally comfortable understanding a legal or operational problem, translating it into a product requirement, and driving it all the way to deployment.

You'll Own

* **Product roadmap:** Owning and driving the roadmap across Webnyay's ODR, arbitration, mediation, BFSI dispute resolution, and grievance redressal products.
* **New feature development:** Identifying high-leverage opportunities from customer feedback, operational bottlenecks, and market requirements. Scoping and shipping capabilities that improve product value and expand our addressable market.
* **Backlog prioritisation:** Turning hundreds of customer requests, change requests, bug reports, and internal ideas into a coherent, prioritised shipping plan. Knowing what to build, what to defer, and what to push back on.
* **Enterprise workflow optimisation:** Understanding end-to-end dispute resolution workflows — from case initiation, notice generation and service, document management, hearings and arbitrator workflows to award generation, closure, billing, and reporting — and continuously improving them.
* **Customer-facing product management:** Working directly with customers, understanding their requirements, managing expectations, communicating feature releases, and handling difficult conversations around timelines, scope, and prioritisation.
* **Product documentation:** Writing clear PRDs, functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and release notes that engineering and implementation teams can execute against.
* **Cross-functional execution:** Working closely with engineering leads, design, legal operations, implementation, business development, and customer success to take features from requirement to production.
* **Product analytics:** Using product usage, operational metrics, customer feedback, and workflow data to identify friction, measure adoption, and make informed product decisions.
* **Competitive positioning:** Tracking the legal-tech, ODR, BFSI technology, and enterprise SaaS landscape to identify product gaps, emerging capabilities, and opportunities to differentiate Webnyay.

You'll work directly with the leadership team and have significant ownership over product decisions and execution.

How We Work: AI-Native by Default

This is important enough to call out clearly: **we expect our Product Managers to use AI across the entire product lifecycle.** AI is not a separate workstream or an occasional productivity tool. It should be embedded in how you research, think, design, document, build, and ship.

That Means

* **Discovery:** Synthesising customer interviews, analysing support tickets and change requests at scale, researching legal and regulatory requirements, and gathering competitive intelligence using AI tools.
* **Definition:** Drafting PRDs, generating user stories, mapping workflows, identifying dependencies, and stress-testing edge cases before handing requirements to engineering.
* **Design:** Creating wireframes, prototyping interfaces, exploring UI variants, and validating user flows using tools such as Figma AI, v0, Lovable, or Claude.
* **Build:** Translating requirements into technical specifications, understanding APIs and system architecture, debugging alongside engineers, and using AI to review code and understand implementation trade-offs.
* **Launch:** Generating release notes, preparing customer communications, creating product documentation, and enabling sales and implementation teams with feature updates.
* **Measure:** Querying product data, analysing adoption and turnaround times, identifying workflow bottlenecks, generating hypotheses, and using AI to accelerate product analysis.
* **Automate:** Identifying repetitive workflows across product, operations, and customer delivery that can be simplified or automated using AI agents and integrations.

We don't expect you to be an engineer. We do expect you to be technically curious, resourceful, and capable of using modern AI tools to move faster and produce better work.

What We're Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B SaaS, enterprise software, fintech, legal-tech, or workflow automation.
* Experience owning an existing product and driving its roadmap, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Strong ability to translate ambiguous business and customer requirements into structured product specifications.
* Experience working with engineering teams and understanding technical trade-offs, APIs, integrations, and software architecture.
* Excellent written communication. You should be able to write a clear PRD, explain a complex workflow, and communicate a product decision without ambiguity.
* Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with data to prioritise opportunities and evaluate outcomes.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and demanding enterprise customers without losing sight of the product roadmap.
* A bias towards execution. You should be someone who takes ownership, follows through, and gets things shipped.
* Genuine interest in AI tools and a willingness to experiment with them as part of your everyday workflow.

**An added advantage:** Experience with legal workflows, arbitration, mediation, BFSI, lending, collections, grievance redressal, regulatory technology, or high-volume transaction platforms.

**Product Management**

**About the Role**

Deloitte is looking for a hands-on product manager to own a product end-to-end within Deloitte Consulting Products. Based in US-India (USI Office), you'll own the day-to-day of a product built for the US market—running discovery, shaping the roadmap, and working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering and design to ship value clients actually use.

This is a builder's role at its core. You're the strongest product craftsperson on your product: closest to the user, closest to the backlog, and accountable for the outcomes it delivers. You'll work with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders to stay grounded in the market you're building for.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Own Your Product**

* Own the roadmap, backlog, and outcomes for your product, turning priorities into a clear plan of what to build next

* Make the day-to-day prioritization and trade-off calls, sequencing work by value, effort, and readiness

* Define and track the metrics that show it's working: adoption, engagement, retention, impact

* Know when something isn't working—flag it early and make the case to change course or stop

**Discover & Validate**

* Run discovery to understand your users and the problems worth solving, partnering with US product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders

* Frame and test hypotheses through user research, prototypes, and rapid validation before building at scale

* Use both generative and evaluative research to answer “are we building the right thing?” and “are we building it right?”

**Ship as One Team**

* Take features and products from concept through define, shape, build, and scale

* Own the product backlog: write clear problem statements, user stories, and acceptance criteria, and keep it groomed and prioritized

* Work as one team with engineering and UX—sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving

* Own launch, adoption, and iteration; instrument the product and act on what the data shows

* Work in an AI-native way, using AI and agentic workflows across discovery, build, and delivery to move faster without cutting corners

**Clients & Go-to-Market**

* Stay close to clients—join demos, discovery sessions, and feedback conversations, and turn what you hear into the roadmap

* Support go-to-market with product marketing, sales, and account teams: positioning, demos, and enablement

* Stay fluent in the US market realities that shape your product: data privacy, SaaS vs. on-prem

**Work Across the Network**

* Partner with Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India to align your product with delivery capacity and real client needs, and be the go-to for questions on your product

* Mentor and lift the product managers and associates around you, modeling strong product craft

Reports to a Senior Manager / AVP of Product Management. Works as one team with engineering and UX, partners with US-based product owners, sponsors, and offering leaders, and collaborates with GTM, account, and Deloitte Consulting Delivery and Practice teams across India.

* Track record of shipping products or major features from discovery to launch, with measurable outcomes

* Strong hands-on product craft: backlog, user stories and acceptance criteria, and working day to day with engineering and design in an agile setup

* Fluent in discovery and validation—user research, hypotheses, prototypes—not just delivery

* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Seasoned as a Product Owner in an agile / Scrum environment

* Zero-to-one product or feature launch experience

* Products, professional services, consulting, or enterprise-technology background

* Experience mentoring junior product owners

**Core Competencies**

* Owns outcomes, not just outputs

* Problem-obsessed and customer-centric

* Strong product craft and delivery discipline

* Bias to action—ships, learns, iterates

* Clear communicator with engineering, design, and stakeholders

* Data-driven, with sound judgment

**Why This Role Matters**

Great products are built by people who stay close to the user and close to the craft. This role owns a product built for the US market from the ground in India—discovering what to build, shipping it as one team with engineering and design, and iterating on what clients actually use. It's where strong product managers do their best hands-on work and grow into the leaders who own portfolios next.

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

* Roadmaps for both domains, including sequencing of a modular, SKU-based product portfolio and defining the scope of each release.

* Voice of customer through continuous discovery with dealerships and dealer groups to validate demand before build.

* Cross-functional delivery in partnership with engineering, design, GTM, legal/compliance, security, and platform teams.

description:
#### **About the company**

Openprovider is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology company founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, Netherlands.  
  
We are a fully-remote organization with more than 90 team members spread across 20+ countries.  
  
A diverse and inclusive organization, we support a healthy work/life balance and are constantly looking for new ways to help the well-being of our people. We support a flexible schedule and are 100% performance and result-oriented.  
  
At Openprovider, we're not just a company; we're a mission-driven team dedicated to transforming the domain industry. We believe in providing a trusted digital identity to every business.  
  
Our innovative approach is reshaping the industry from a traditional transactional model to a more customer-centric, subscription-based approach. We pay subscriptions for music, newspapers, and movies - why should domains be any different?  
  
Our vision is to build a place where curious, self-driven people do their best work together, to deliver on our mission: a reliable, free, and secure online world for every customer we serve. Our world is changing fast, especially with AI, and we see that as an opportunity to stay ahead of change, shape it and create more value for our customers.  
  
**Our values**

* **Be a wolf, not a sheep:** we value the entrepreneurial spirit in everyone.
* **Knowledge equals power:** we are constantly hungry to learn, for ourselves and our customers.
* **Enjoy what you do and do what you enjoy:** we want work to be something you look forward to.
* **Quality results in quantity:** we care about excellence and attention to detail.
* **TEAM, Together everyone achieves more:** collaboration is how we get our best results.

Come join us on our journey to create a trusted digital world.

#### **About the role**

In this role, you’ll build a profitable and sustainable products business alongside our domains portfolio. Your scope will include SSL certificates, Email and Plesk as commercial product lines, as well as the RCP (reseller control panel) journeys that enable our resellers to purchase, provision, manage and renew these products.

You’ll be accountable for their financial performance and quality, while managing supplier partnerships to keep our offering competitive and future-proof. The role reports to the Director of Product.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own the SSL, Email and Plesk portfolio and P&L: positioning, assortment, pricing proposals (with Pricing and Finance), margin and lifecycle decisions from launch to sunset.
* Own supplier partnerships with Certificate Authorities, our email platform provider and Plesk/WebPros: contracts, volume tiers, rebates, SLAs, roadmap alignment and escalations.
* Grow adoption across our reseller base through cross-sell with domains and hosting, bundles, purchase journey placement and launches with Sales and Marketing.
* Run product initiatives as structured projects, including supplier integrations, API changes and compliance changes such as CA/B Forum rules.
* Shape the product roadmap with a commercial lens and partner with Engineering on delivery.
* Track results against clear targets: margin and revenue per product line, attach and renewal rates, and on-time delivery of milestones and roadmap items.

#### **What we are looking for**

**Competences**

* **Hosting & Security Products Knowledge:** Solid understanding of SSL/TLS certificates (DV/OV/EV, validation, CA/B Forum requirements and lifecycle changes), email hosting and anti-spam, and Plesk licensing and hosting control panels.
* **Supplier & Vendor Management:** Negotiates commercial terms, volume tiers, rebates and SLAs; runs business reviews; manages supplier performance, dependency and contract risk.
* **Commercial & P&L Acumen:** Builds business cases; understands pricing, margin, unit economics, cannibalisation and reseller incentive models.
* **Product Strategy & Roadmapping:** Translates strategy into operational roadmaps for the RCP and the SSL, email and Plesk product lines.
* **Project & Programme Management:** Plans and delivers multi-party projects with Engineering and suppliers: scope, milestones, dependencies, risk logs and stakeholder updates, within a strong Agile/EOS rhythm.
* **Data & Funnel Analytics:** Instruments and analyses order, provisioning and renewal journeys; separates price effects from product effects.
* **AI Proficiency:** Embeds AI tools across daily work - discovery, documentation, analysis, supplier communication and GTM.

**How we work at Openprovider**

* **Self-management:** you own your time, priorities and results, and raise issues early.
* **Learning Agility and AI Literacy:** you learn fast and use AI with confidence and good judgement.
* **Adaptive Innovation Mindset:** you see change as a chance to improve and help others move forward positively.
* **Quality Orientation:** you take pride in your work, test assumptions with facts and deliver results others can rely on.
* **Customer Focus:** you understand who your work serves, including our resellers, and make decisions that create real value for them.

#### **What we offer**

* 100% remote work (you can work from any location, no need to go to the office);
* Paid time off and sick leave;
* International team and regular online and offline events to stay connected;
* Internal workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions;
* Quarterly review and annual salary review;
* Flexible working hours;
* We are an ISO 27001-certified remote workplace;
* Meaningful work with real ownership and room to stretch beyond your comfort zone;
* Courses in the Openprovider Academy, a structured onboarding path and a clear Career Framework to manage your own growth;
* A Virtual Office that makes it easy to connect with colleagues, wherever you are.

Openprovider is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We welcome all qualified candidates to apply.

#### **About us**

Most resellers spend too much money and time on domains. With Openprovider and our Membership program, you can buy, renew, and transfer domains at cost price on one platform to become a more successful and profitable reseller.  
  
We are a rapidly-growing, ICANN-accredited domain registrar and technology scale-up founded in 2004 in Rotterdam, the Netherlands. We understand the frustrations of wasting hours searching for new domains at fair prices; being hit by unexpected renewal costs after the first year; and losing customers because you can’t offer attractive bundles.  
  
That’s why we built a platform to easily manage operations for over 1,900 domain extensions. We were the first to offer a Membership Program to get the domains you need at cost price, and we've been helping clients sell millions of domains for more than 20 years.  
  
We have been fully remote since 2020, and our team has only expanded since then. Our team currently consists of 90+ employees, who are spread across 20+ different countries and 4 different continents. We are proud of our fun and diverse team and regularly connect with each other through online and offline events.

title: Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain - Product Manager II
description:
**Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners (FDDPs) – Healthcare Domain**

**Converge for Healthcare | Deloitte Consulting**

**About the Role**

**The Team**

This role sits within Converge for Healthcare, Deloitte's industry-focused asset studio for healthcare, part of Deloitte Consulting's Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) practice. I&DT brings an engineering- and innovation-led mindset to how Deloitte builds, delivers, and scales technology-enabled solutions.

Data Studio is Converge for Healthcare's foundational platform—combining agentic AI and analytics capabilities atop a unified healthcare data foundation to turn healthcare data into decision-ready insight and automated action across the Converge for Healthcare product portfolio.

Forward Deployed Domain Practitioners are the business and domain half of Converge for Healthcare's Forward Deployed model. Where Product Forward Deployed Engineers (pFDEs) cover product and technology, FDDPs cover business and domain—partnering with pFDEs, client account teams, and product teams to define the real client problem, prove measurable value, and identify where the platform can deliver more, feeding real-world domain learnings back into the platform roadmap.

**Position Summary**

As a Forward Deployed Domain Practitioner within Converge for Healthcare, you will work directly with clients, Deloitte Consulting's broader Health Care consulting practice, and Converge Health's product and engineering teams. Paired with a pFDE on each engagement, you'll bring the client-domain fluency that shapes what gets built on Data Studio and why—defining the business problem and success criteria, aligning client stakeholders on what value means, and translating real operational workflows into the requirements, rules, and edge cases the pFDE builds against.

This is a domain-led, business-facing role grounded in production reality rather than abstract requirements. You'll work alongside real users, real workflows, and real data, on engagements that are scoped, time-boxed, and exit-oriented—leaving behind documented domain artifacts and reusable patterns so that each deployment makes the next one materially faster.

The role draws on healthcare breadth rather than a single specialty, spanning provider and payer domains—from revenue cycle, utilization management, and clinical operations to network strategy, risk adjustment, actuarial, and beyond.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Work You'll Do**

* **Presales & opportunity shaping:** Partner with Health Care consulting teams, account teams, and pFDEs during the sales cycle—leading business discovery, mapping current-state workflows, and building the value hypothesis and business case, while the pFDE leads technical discovery and demonstrations, to qualify client needs into Product fit or out to Services as custom scope.

* **Business problem definition & success criteria:** Frame each use case around a concrete operational problem, establish baseline performance, and define measurable outcomes the client and Deloitte agree on (e.g., denial rates, days in A/R, prior authorization turnaround, coding accuracy, care-gap closure).

* **Domain-to-build translation:** Translate business needs into the workflow logic, decision rules, policy references, exceptions, and acceptance criteria the pFDE builds against—and contribute domain-accurate, labelled test cases to the use case's evaluation set so agent outputs are judged against how the work is actually done.

* **Use case discovery beyond the original ask:** Surface adjacent, domain-specific use cases grounded in what you observe in the client's workflows and data, size their value, and route them through engagement governance and the product roadmap—never through informal commitments on features or timelines.

* **Stakeholder alignment & adoption:** Build alignment among client executives, operational leaders, and front-line users on what value means for the engagement, and lead the process change, training, and adoption activities that turn a working capability into one people actually use.

* **Value realization & measurement:** Stay engaged post-launch to track outcomes against the agreed baseline, diagnose where value is or isn't landing, and develop the evidence and client value stories that support adoption, renewal, and platform growth.

* **Field-to-product feedback & reusable domain assets:** Capture recurring domain patterns, workflow variations, and policy or regulatory shifts, translate them into concrete use-case and capability requests for Product Managers, and codify them into reusable domain playbooks, value frameworks, and use-case definitions for the next client.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 8+ years of experience in healthcare consulting, provider or payer operations, or a domain-specialist role in healthcare technology

* 4+ years of client-facing experience leading business discovery, process redesign, or business case development

* Comfortable client-facing, including product demos and discovery with senior stakeholders

* Based in India, able to work virtually with US stakeholders on US-market direction and its nuances

**Preferred**

* Master's degree in Healthcare Administration, Business, Public Health, Health Informatics, Nursing or another clinical discipline, such as an MBA, MHA, or MPH, or another relevant advanced degree

* Relevant professional credentials (e.g., HFMA CRCR or CHFP, AAPC or AHIMA coding certifications, clinical licensure such as RN, or SOA actuarial credentials)

* Experience with AI, automation, or advanced analytics implementations in a healthcare setting

* Experience in product- or platform-based delivery models, as distinct from purely services-based delivery

**Core Competencies**

* Domain-first profile—deep healthcare business and operational expertise paired with enough technical fluency to partner credibly with engineers on agentic AI and data solutions

* Strong healthcare domain knowledge spanning provider and/or payer domains—such as revenue cycle, utilization management, care management, clinical operations, network strategy, risk adjustment, or actuarial—with the versatility to apply it across multiple areas rather than a single specialty

* Proven ability to diagnose operational workflows, quantify improvement opportunities, and build credible business cases and ROI models that client executives act on

* Practical understanding of what agentic AI can and cannot do reliably—human-in-the-loop design, accuracy-versus-automation trade-offs, and how to judge agent outputs for domain correctness—without needing to write code

* Working knowledge of healthcare data and data standards (e.g., claims, remittances, EMR data, X12 EDI, HL7, FHIR) at a business level—what the data means, where it breaks, and how data quality affects business outcomes

* Fluency in the regulatory and policy landscape that shapes healthcare workflows—such as CMS rules, payer medical and reimbursement policies, coding standards (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS), prior authorization requirements, and HIPAA

* Strong requirements and process skills—process mapping, decision tables, use-case definition, and acceptance criteria that engineers can build and test against

* Judgment to size each engagement—recognizing when a client problem maps to a proven use case, when it needs meaningful extension, and when it is custom scope better served by Services

* Commercial instinct grounded in client value—spotting where the platform can do more for a client and framing it in outcome terms, while respecting engagement governance and the product roadmap

* Change management and adoption experience, including redesigning roles and workflows around automation and bringing front-line teams along

* Intellectual curiosity about how AI is changing the way healthcare work gets done, and a strong pull toward rethinking workflows rather than automating them as they are

* Executive presence and client-facing credibility to lead business conversations with senior stakeholders while working fluidly with engineering and product teams in the same engagement

* Ability to build trust and durable working relationships quickly with client stakeholders and account teams in predominantly virtual and distributed delivery environments

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to develop client-facing materials and business cases, lead discovery workshops, and work effectively across distributed teams and international time zones

**Our purpose**

  
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Our people and culture**

  
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

**Professional development**

  
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India.

**Benefits to help you thrive**

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Recruiting tips**

Our customers range from small and medium businesses to large enterprises and public sector organizations. Our products empower procurement leaders, finance teams, and business administrators to understand organizational spending, identify savings opportunities, monitor purchasing behavior, and make informed business decisions.  
  
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Technical (PMT) to help shape and deliver the next generation of Amazon Business Analytics experiences. In this role, you will drive product strategy and execution across our customer facing analytics portfolio, spanning spend visibility, self service reporting, intelligent insights, and AI powered conversational analytics. You will build intuitive and scalable products for the full range of business customers, from those seeking simple, out of the box spending insights to large enterprises requiring sophisticated analytics across complex organizational structures.  
  
You will have the opportunity to reimagine how business customers interact with their purchasing data, moving beyond traditional dashboards and reports toward intelligent, proactive, and conversational experiences. You will use advances in generative AI, large language models, and modern data technologies to make analytics more accessible, personalized, and actionable for customers worldwide.

description:
**Senior Product Manager**

**Response Automation (SIEM and SOAR)**

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the automation foundations that help security teams and AI agents turn detections into fast, safe, consistent response.

Finding a threat is half the job. Analysts still spend too much time enriching alerts, chasing context, opening tickets, and running containment steps by hand. As AI agents take on more of that work, response automation has to be dependable, auditable, and easy to control. This role owns the playbook, orchestration, and case management capabilities across Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR that make that possible.

You will own established automation capabilities while building toward agent-driven response and a tighter SIEM-to-SOAR experience. This is a technically deep role. It requires first-hand experience with security operations, SOAR, or workflow automation products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into capabilities that SOC teams adopt and trust.

**What You Will Own**

**Playbooks and the automation engine.** The playbook editor, triggers, actions, execution engine, and the Automation Service. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing power, ease of use, and cost for analysts, detection engineers, and agents.

**Cloud SIEM and Cloud SOAR together.** Define how insights and signals in Cloud SIEM trigger automations and hand off to Cloud SOAR for incident and case management. Establish where the Automation Service ends and full Cloud SOAR begins, with clear packaging, upgrade paths, and one coherent customer experience.

**Integrations, actions, and App Central.** Set the strategy for enrichment, notification, containment, user choice, and custom actions. Prioritize integrations across endpoint, identity, cloud, ticketing, threat intelligence, and messaging tools. Own coverage, quality, and lifecycle for out-of-the-box playbooks and integrations.

**Agentic and human-in-the-loop response.** Define how AI agents discover, invoke, and chain playbooks and actions. Establish the approval steps, scoped permissions, guardrails, and audit trails that let customers decide which responses run automatically and which need an analyst's sign-off.

  

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for response automation, connecting current SOC needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation and response.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping playbook, automation, and case management capabilities, using customer feedback and execution data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on execution reliability, scalability, error handling, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate response use cases, such as phishing, compromised identity, and endpoint containment, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the integration and action strategy, including how actions are named, scoped, versioned, and made safe to run without a person watching.
* Partner with detection, investigation, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared automation capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure automation respects established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure playbook success rate, time to respond, analyst time saved, reliability, cost, and adoption, and show how automation improvements lead to better security outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of security operations, SOAR, SIEM, or workflow automation products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of incident response workflows, orchestration engines, event-driven systems, APIs, and the integrations that connect security tools.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams, partners, or external developers.
* The ability to reason about automation risk, including false positives, partial failures, and the point where a human should approve an action.
* Familiarity with SOC operations and frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and the NIST incident response lifecycle. Experience with case management, threat intelligence, or integration marketplaces is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover tools, take actions, and operate within guardrails, or the ability to ramp quickly. Hands-on SOC or security engineering experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in response time, analyst workload, or risk reduction.
* **Safety and trust.** Treats control, auditability, and predictable behavior as product requirements, especially when automation takes action on its own.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

**Overview**

Role: **Senior Product Manager**

Grow the subscription people are glad they pay for.

With millions of active users across the Microsoft 365 ecosystem and Copilot usage growing fast, consumer subscriptions are one of the largest surfaces anywhere to shape the next chapter of Microsoft's subscription business. Copilot is making Microsoft 365 more powerful every month, and that creates a rare opportunity: help more people subscribe, help subscribers discover the plan that fits them best, and invent new ways to pay for AI as it becomes part of everyday life. We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own consumer monetization on mobile, a business with enormous reach where the playbook for AI subscriptions is still being written.

Why this role, why now

Copilot recently came together as one app across web, desktop and mobile, and AI is reshaping what people expect from a subscription. Plans now range from core productivity to Copilot-powered and Pro experiences, and usage-based offers are opening entirely new business models. Early signals on mobile are solid, and in-app purchase is live across iOS and Android. This is the moment to define what a world-class AI subscription business looks like.

How we work

* Small, empowered mission teams with clear ownership.
* Every bet starts with a written hypothesis, is measured rigorously, and decisions are made on evidence.
* AI-native by default: we use AI agents and tools throughout our own workflow to research, prototype, analyze and ship faster.
* Ship fast, learn faster, scale what works.
* We earn the upgrade; we never trap people in a subscription.
* India shapes global strategy here, not just execution.

You'll thrive here if...

* You treat a paywall as a product and can explain why one trial converts and another does not.
* You are excited by inventing new ways to pay for AI, from premium tiers to usage-based packs.
* You form a view on why people pay, and change it quickly when the data disagrees.
* App store policies energize your creativity rather than limit it.
* You think in lifetime value, not just conversion, and are as comfortable modelling unit economics with finance as sketching a flow with a designer.
* You already prototype, analyze and write with AI, and want a team that expects it.

This role may not be for you if...

* You want a defined backlog handed to you.
* You measure success by features shipped rather than customers who pay and stay.
* Dark patterns tempt you.

Why join us

Few roles let you shape how millions of people experience and pay for AI in their daily lives. You will own a global subscription business across growth, economics, upgrades and new business models, with the freedom to set direction and a fast-moving, AI-native team beside you. description:
**Organization:**  
At CommBank, you will work in an environment that aims to combine the scale and responsibility of Australia's leading bank with empowered, product-led teams. Our best teams are outcome-focused and take end-to-end ownership. That means staying close to the customer problem, using evidence to make decisions, being clear about trade-offs, learning quickly and owning what we build through its full lifecycle. It also means delivering safely and sustainably: risk, resilience and controls are part of good product design, not something added at the end. We value people who demonstrate Care, Courage and Commitment. You will have the opportunity to work on a material payments problem, own an important product area within a new strategic capability, collaborate with deep payments and technology specialists, and explore how automation and emerging AI can responsibly transform payment servicing.

**Job Title:** Senior Product Lead

**Location:** Bangalore

**Business & Team:**

As Product Lead - Payment Exceptions & Investigations, you will own a defined product area within the broader Payment Exceptions & Investigations product stream. Working within the product strategy and direction established for the stream, you will translate customer and operational problems into clear product outcomes, priorities and an executable roadmap for your squad. You will lead the product lifecycle for your area from discovery and problem definition through delivery, adoption, run performance and continuous optimisation. You will make evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology and delivery considerations, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture, Payments Operations, frontline teams, Risk and other specialist teams.

You will work closely with other Product Leads and Product Managers across the PEX stream to ensure your product area contributes to coherent end-to-end payment exception journeys and reusable capabilities rather than creating isolated solutions.

**Impact & contribution:**

As a Product Lead within the Payments Channel and Reporting Crew, you will work closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes for our business stakeholders and customers. You will be responsible for developing and delivering customer reporting capability for the Payments Domain. This will incorporate the delivery of reports, modernisation of existing reporting capabilities and development of the strategic roadmap for future state delivery. You will be leading a team of engineering experts to achieve this, while creating a psychologically safe, inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture, and working collaboratively within and across Crews.

  

**Reporting lines:** Dhivya Elanchezhian – Senior Product Capability Lead

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the product vision, outcomes and roadmap for a defined Payment Exceptions & Investigations product area, aligned to the overall PEX product strategy.
* Deeply understand the customer, colleague and operational problems within your product area through discovery, data, research and engagement with frontline and operational teams.
* Translate those problems into clearly defined product opportunities, measurable outcomes and prioritised initiatives.
* Own squad-level prioritisation and roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology, delivery constraints and expected business outcomes.
* Lead discovery and delivery of reusable product capabilities that contribute to the broader PEX target state rather than creating point solutions for individual processes or systems.
* Shape simple experiences for customers, bankers, investigators and payment operations colleagues within your product area.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on product and engineering trade-offs, feasibility, sequencing, integration and delivery confidence
* Identify opportunities to move journeys from manual handling toward assisted resolution and straight-through processing where policy, evidence and controls support it.
* Explore practical applications of automation and AI for use cases such as context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation support, next-best-action and response drafting.
Ensure AI-enabled and automated outcomes within your product area are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.Use customer, operational and product data to understand product performance, identify recurring pain points and continuously optimise outcomes.Define and own measurable product outcomes relevant to your area, which may include resolution time, straightthrough-processing rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness and colleague adoption.Embed risk, controls, regulatory and operational resilience considerations throughout discovery, design, delivery and ongoing product management.Lead and develop Product Managers within your squad/product area and contribute to strong product discipline across the broader PEX stream.Partner with other PEX Product Leads and Product Managers to manage dependencies and deliver consistent endto-end customer and colleague outcomes.  

**Essential Skills:**

We’re interested in hearing from people who:

* Bring strong product management and product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous optimisation.
* Have payments domain knowledge, ideally across Australian domestic and/or international payments, payment processing, exceptions or servicing.
* Understand, or are able to develop strong knowledge of, payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and international/correspondent banking.

* Demonstrate strong product discovery, customer research, roadmap, prioritisation and lifecycle-management disciplines.

* Are comfortable making evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational outcomes, technology, risk and delivery considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and customer-facing teams.Understand risk, controls and operational resilience and embed them into product decisions rather than treating them as downstream gates.
* Are curious about automation, AI and emerging technologies and can identify where they create genuine customer or operational value.
Coach Product Managers, create clarity through ambiguity and build collaborative, outcome-focused teams  

**Years of Experience:** 11+
  
We are seeking an experienced Product Lead with business/product background and payments domain expertise.

description:
**Charles River Development | Platform UI Framework**

**Who We’re Looking For**

* We are seeking an Associate Technical Product Manager to lead roadmap execution for foundational user interface capabilities within the Charles River and Alpha Platforms.
* This role is ideal for a technically minded product professional with 9+ years of experience across product management, business analysis, quality assurance, software development, UX, or related technology disciplines who is curious, hands-on, and comfortable using modern tools to solve problems independently. We are looking for someone fluent in generative AI tools, modern web technologies, APIs, data, and user experience, and who naturally looks for faster and better ways to get work done.
* You do not need to be a software engineer, but you should be comfortable working with technology directly. For example, rather than defaulting to a PowerPoint presentation, you might use AI-assisted tools to quickly create a more compelling interactive presentation. Rather than requesting a new report, you might use an available API and tools such as VS Code and GitHub Copilot to prototype a simple web application that answers the question.
* Rather than manually analyzing a large set of product feedback, you might use an LLM to help identify themes and then validate the results yourself.
* We are looking for someone who combines this builder mindset with strong product judgment, an understanding of user experience, and the ability to lead product discovery and execution in a complex enterprise environment.
  

  

**Why This Role Is Important to Us**

* You will join the Platform UI Framework team within the Charles River Investment Management Solution (CRIMS), a market-leading SaaS platform that powers front-to-back investment workflows for some of the world’s largest financial institutions.
* As we scale our platform, your talent will be critical in evolving our foundational UI capabilities, improving developer and user experiences, and enabling rapid innovation across the organization.
* Your ability to combine product leadership with practical technical fluency will help the team investigate product questions, communicate ideas, and validate solutions more quickly.
  

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Collect and refine business and functional requirements from clients, engineering, architecture, security, operations, and other stakeholders, ensuring platform capabilities meet user, performance, scalability, security, and compliance needs.
* Lead product discovery and technical deep dives, translating complex user and platform needs into clear product requirements, prioritized backlogs, and actionable roadmaps.
* Own roadmap execution for foundational UI capabilities such as reusable web components, desktop containers, interoperability, design systems, and core UI services.
* Engage with engineering and QA members throughout delivery to clarify requirements, evaluate trade-offs, remove ambiguity, and support the timely delivery of key initiatives.
* Partner with UX designers and engineers to create experiences that are intuitive, efficient, accessible, consistent, and technically achievable.
* Use modern technology, including AI-assisted tools, APIs, automation, and lightweight prototyping, to independently investigate product questions, analyze data, communicate ideas, and validate potential solutions.
* Create lightweight prototypes, scripts, visualizations, or web applications when a tangible artifact will produce better insight or stakeholder feedback than a traditional document or presentation.
* Promote a smooth developer experience by helping ensure platform services, components, documentation, and workflows are understandable and intuitive.
* Use product analytics, user feedback, and direct stakeholder engagement to understand adoption, identify friction, and shape roadmap priorities.
* Become a subject matter expert in the coverage area and provide informed recommendations that help shape product strategy and growth.
* Support sales, professional services, and client support activities to improve the client experience and inform future product investments.
  

  

**Qualifications**

* 9+ years of experience in technical product management, business analysis, platform engineering, UX, software development, or a related technology role within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Strong understanding of product management practices, including discovery, requirements definition, user stories, prioritization, roadmaps, iterative delivery, and stakeholder management.
* Strong interest in user experience and interaction design, with the ability to understand complex workflows and identify opportunities to simplify them.
* Technical fluency with modern web applications, including familiarity with React, JavaScript or TypeScript, REST APIs, JSON, authentication, web services, and cloud-based applications.
* Demonstrated ability to use generative AI and AI-assisted tools as part of everyday work, including research, analysis, prototyping, communication, coding, and problem solving.
* Comfort using tools such as VS Code, GitHub, GitHub Copilot, command-line utilities, APIs, and browser developer tools to explore ideas and solve problems independently.
* Ability to create lightweight prototypes, scripts, visualizations, or web applications to explore a product idea or answer a business question. Production-level software engineering experience is not required.
* Comfort working with data and selecting the right tool for the problem, whether Excel, SQL, an API, Power BI, or a lightweight custom application.
* Proven ability to work with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-impact platform capabilities.
* Strong technical acumen and the ability to engage meaningfully with engineers, architects, designers, security teams, and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with Azure cloud services and enterprise security or compliance requirements is beneficial.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, Figma, GitHub, or similar product development tools is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Human-Computer Interaction, Product Design, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in financial services, enterprise SaaS, or another regulated industry is a plus.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
